description: This file implements the ViewerPage React component for a document management frontend, allowing users to view documents (especially PDFs) with inline rendering, signed URL fetching, PDF.js integration, and document list management.

methods.name: useQueryParam
methods.description: Custom hook to retrieve a query parameter value from the URL search parameters.

methods.name: inferIsPdf
methods.description: Function to infer whether a document is a PDF based on mime type and filename extension.

methods.name: openSignedUrlInline
methods.description: Function to fetch a signed URL, create a Blob URL for inline display, with fallback to direct URL opening.

methods.name: ViewerPage
methods.description: Main React component rendering the document viewer page with list, metadata, and PDF viewing capabilities.
